id_grammar.case: lowercase ASCII only; compared byte for byte; never folded
id_grammar.normalization: none: any other spelling is refused, never rewritten

types.name: world
types.doc: a playable world: the content of an OALMAP package, listed in its provides

types.name: entity
types.doc: a placement inside one world (button, relay, door, trigger, teleport); links and world.entity() name it

types.name: mover
types.doc: a reusable mover (size, travel, speed) that placed movers name; inside its world only

types.name: script
types.doc: host-side Lua source (megamod.v1); a world's own, or imported from a library package (X4)

types.name: character
types.doc: an imported character (.oalasset); still loaded by file name, its ID is audit-only

types.name: weapon
types.doc: an imported weapon (.oalasset); still loaded by file name, its ID is audit-only

types.name: sounds
types.doc: the UI sound pack: a container of role-named clips (.oalasset kind sounds); loaded by file name, its ID is audit-only -- one addressable clip is a 'sound'

types.name: model
types.doc: a static mesh (mesh1) drawn with its material slots; a library provides it, a world's props place it

types.name: material
types.doc: a surface: one texture and a draw mode (opaque, alpha); a model's slots name it

types.name: texture
types.doc: an RGBA8 image in a library package; a material names it

types.name: sound
types.doc: one clip of 16-bit PCM in a library package; a mover definition may name it (not the UI 'sounds' pack)

types.name: animation
types.doc: reserved: a clip for a skeleton

types.name: prefab
types.doc: a reusable composition of entity kinds and resources; a library provides it, a world places instances that expand into ordinary entities at load

references.label: link target
references.resolves: same package

references.label: definition
references.resolves: same package
references.doc: a placed mover's definition; in the same world

references.label: script
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: an interactable's script (declares on_used); the world's own or imported (X4)

references.label: ability script
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: the script answering a player's ability press (declares on_ability); the world's own or imported (X4)

references.label: world.entity

references.doc: a script asks for a placed entity's handle while it loads; in the world being played

references.label: import
references.resolves: the required package it is listed under
references.doc: a resource a package takes from a package it requires; that package must provide it

references.label: texture
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: the texture a material draws with; the library's own or imported

references.label: material slot
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: a model's material slots, in slot order; the library's own or imported

references.label: model
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: the model a placed prop draws (and collides as its bounds); imported from a library

references.label: sound
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: the sound a mover makes when it starts to open or close; imported from a library

references.label: model
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: a prefab child's model (a prop's, or what draws a mover); resolved from the prefab's own package: its own or imported

references.label: sound
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: a prefab mover child's sound; resolved from the prefab's own package: its own or imported

references.label: script
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: a prefab interactable child's script (declares on_used); resolved from the prefab's own package: its own or imported

references.label: prefab
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package

references.label: binding source
references.resolves: same package
references.doc: the placement whose event a binding listens to; in the same world (a prefab child's placed ID too)

references.label: condition entity
references.resolves: same package
references.doc: the placement a binding's condition reads; in the same world

references.label: action target
references.resolves: same package
references.doc: the placement a binding's action is requested of; in the same world

references.label: sound position
references.resolves: same package
references.doc: the placement a binding's sound plays at; in the same world

references.label: sound
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: the sound a binding's play_sound action plays; imported from a library

references.label: sound
references.resolves: same package, or an import from a required package
references.doc: the sound a prefab binding's play_sound action plays; resolved from the prefab's own package: its own or imported

fields.provides: every resource the package defines except placements; canonical byte order; each once; must equal the content
fields.requires: [{package, resources}] in canonical package-ID order; resources: the imports, canonical order, each provided by that package

package.implicit: a manifest with no package member (every pre-X4 package): provides what it defines, requires nothing

library.container: OALASSET v1, kind library: the manifest, then the payload of its asset members (X5), nothing else
library.provides: its scripts and its assets, exactly

package.graph: package requirements are acyclic (a cycle is refused with its path); each package loads once; the set is kept sorted by package ID; references may only reach the package itself or its declared imports

world_key.dependencies: after the members: per package of the closure, sorted by package ID: OALD, u32 ID length, ID, u64 digest (FNV-1a 64 of OALL, u32 schema, its library members; then, when it declares assets, OALP, u32 payload length and every payload byte)

members.order: canonical byte order of path, each once; the payload is the members' bytes in this order, right after the manifest
members.use: every member backs exactly one resource; every resource's member exists

member_path.form: segment(/segment)*, the last with one extension: name.ext
member_path.identity: none: storage inside the package; never a host path, never a resource ID

texture.payload: width x height x 4 bytes, rows top down

material.schema_2: emissive 0..4 times base RGB; roughness 0..1 controls local specular width; schema 1 defaults unchanged

model.payload: MSH1, u32 vertex, index, group counts; vertices of 10 f32 (position, normal, uv, lightmap uv; |v| <= 4096); u32 indices; groups of u32 first, count, material slot, contiguous from 0

sound.payload: frames x channels x 2 bytes, interleaved, little endian

assets.lists: canonical byte order of id, each once; every descriptor field required, nothing else allowed
assets.runtime: decoded once when the package set loads into one table (by package ID, then resource ID, per type); placements hold indices; a resource imported by several consumers or placed many times exists once

schemas.2: X7: adds a prefab's bindings; a schema 1 member is read exactly as before and may not hold them

bindings.form: as world_entities.bindings, but source, conditions[].entity, actions[].target and actions[].at name the prefab's children by local id; a play_sound's sound resolves from the prefab's own package
bindings.order: canonical byte order of id, each once in the prefab
bindings.expansion: per instance, after its children: each local child becomes that instance's own entity

children.space: prefab space: +z up, the instance's origin at 0; the world's own parameter meanings
children.mover: size, move and speed inline (it becomes its own mover definition when expanded); an optional model draws it, its origin at the box's centre
children.links: {event, input, target}: target is a sibling's local id; the source must emit the event and the target accept the input; no self-link, no cycle, chains of at most 16

local_id.identity: local: never a resource ID; unique within its prefab (children) or world (instances)

child_entity.why: neither part may hold __, so the split is unique; a schema 5 world's own placed IDs may not hold __ either

prefabs.order: prefabs in canonical byte order of id, children in canonical byte order of local id, each once; a world's instances in canonical byte order of id; expansion appends, after the world's own entities, each instance's children in that order
prefabs.references: a child's model, sound and script resolve from the prefab's own package (its own or its imports); a world imports only the prefab

nesting.refusal: a child of kind prefab, or naming a prefab, is refused

prefabs.overrides: none: an instance is the prefab, an instance id and a transform

transform.yaw_degrees: about +z, counter-clockwise seen from above (+x turns toward +y); |yaw| <= 360; exact at multiples of 90
transform.composition: child world pos = I.pos + I.scale * Rz(I.yaw) * c.pos; yaw = I.yaw + c.yaw; scale = I.scale; a mover's move turns with the instance, its box with its own yaw too; reach, size, move and speed scale
transform.triggers: axis-aligned boxes: an instance holding a trigger must have a yaw that is a multiple of 90
transform.collision: a prop and a prefab mover collide as their oriented box (the drawn model's bounds, turned and scaled)

prefabs.runtime: expanded once when the world loads into ordinary placed entities (the same arrays, handles, links, collision, replication, scripts); nothing during play knows a prefab

world_entities.prop: schema 4: {id, kind prop, links [], model, position}: draws its model where it stands, solid as the model's bounds
world_entities.mover_sound: schema 4: a mover definition's optional sound, played when a mover starts to open or close
world_entities.prop_transform: schema 5: a prop's optional yaw_degrees and scale (see prefabs.transform)

prefab_instances.order: canonical byte order of id, each once
prefab_instances.reserved: a schema 5 world's own placed IDs may not hold __

visual.dynamic_state: optional relay ID reads X8 replicated logical state

bindings.id: a local id (prefabs.local_id), unique in its world or prefab
bindings.order: canonical byte order of id, each once

events.name: used
events.when: a player pressed use at it (the host's interaction, before the game update); the actor is that player

events.name: activated
events.when: it was told to activate (a link, a binding or Lua's world.send), when the queue dispatches that; the X1 link name is 'fired'

events.name: entered
events.when: a player's body went from outside its box to inside (the host's trigger sensing); the actor is that player

events.name: deactivated
events.when: it was told to deactivate, when the queue dispatches that

events.name: opened
events.when: its phase became open (it arrived, or was told to open while already at the end of its travel)

events.name: closed
events.when: its phase became closed (it arrived, or was told to close while already at the start of its travel)

conditions.name: mover_state
conditions.doc: the mover's phase now (Lua's world.state reads the same)

conditions.name: relay_state
conditions.doc: active after activate, inactive after deactivate; every relay starts a round inactive

actions.name: open
actions.subject: the target
actions.path: the world-event queue, as a link's open

actions.name: close
actions.subject: the target
actions.path: the world-event queue, as a link's close

actions.name: toggle
actions.subject: the target
actions.path: the world-event queue, as a link's toggle

actions.name: activate
actions.subject: the target
actions.path: the world-event queue, as a link's activate

actions.name: deactivate
actions.subject: the target
actions.path: the world-event queue (X7's one new input: the relay goes inactive)

actions.name: teleport
actions.subject: the event's actor
actions.path: the world-event queue, as a link's teleport: the event's actor to the target's destination, once per step

actions.name: damage
actions.subject: the event's actor
actions.path: hta_game_hurt, the native damage pipeline (as Lua's game.damage), on the event's actor, attributed to no player

actions.name: play_sound
actions.subject: the place
actions.path: a world sound cue (X5, as a mover's), at `at` or the source; sent to joiners as a world-sound effect

actions.name: use
actions.subject: the target
actions.path: hta_went_use, the one use path a player's press takes after its reach test: the target's cooldown, its `used` event (links, bindings) and its script's on_used; the event's actor, if any, is the user

arguments.target: a placed entity (world) or local child id (prefab); its kind must afford the action
arguments.at: a placed entity (or child) with a position; default the source

bindings.seam: every requester (a player's press after its reach test, Lua's world.send, a binding, a future agent) asks hta_went_request for an action on a target for an actor; the target's kind must afford it; the bounded queue dispatches it into the one engine path; the result is queued, rejected, refused here (a joiner) or queue full

semantics.conditions: all must hold; read when the event is delivered, the same state for every binding of that event; read-only
semantics.ordering: per event: its links in authored order, then its bindings in canonical order (the world's own by id, then each prefab instance's by instance id and binding id); a binding's actions in authored order; all queued, dispatched first in first out
semantics.cycles: allowed (conditions may break them); every cascade is bounded by chain_depth and cascade_actions, then dropped with a diagnostic naming the binding
semantics.authority: host (or offline) only; a joiner never evaluates a binding: it receives the resulting state (WORLD_STATE, WORLD, kills) and a binding's sound as a world-sound effect
semantics.lua: a scripted interactable's on_used runs in the script phase, after its links' and bindings' actions were queued and before they dispatch; its requests queue after them

phase: host.interact: use presses -> used (links, bindings queued; scripted uses recorded)
round restart (relays inactive, movers closed, the queue and cascades emptied)
host.world.dispatch: the queue, first in first out, 256 per step; a relay's activated/deactivated and a mover told to open at the end of its travel emit here and queue behind
world.movers: movers move; arriving -> opened/closed, queued for the next step's dispatch
host.apply: teleports, damage (hta_game_hurt), sounds (and the world-sound effect to joiners)

identity.runtime: every placed or expanded entity, in compiled order: the host simulates by it; links, bindings, Lua handles and traces name it
identity.spatial: movers only, in runtime order: WORLD_STATE's mover index
identity.logical: relays only, in runtime order: WORLD_STATE's flag index
identity.host_only: every other kind: no replicated slot, no bytes
identity.requests: no client message names an object: a press is controls, the host finds the target by its reach test

encoding.snapshot: header + per 255 movers a spatial run + 1 byte a resting mover, 3 a moving one + (any relays) a flag run + ceil(relays / 8)

mover.replicated: phase, progress (1 byte at rest, 3 moving)
